name: FAMAS F1
description:
A Lysorian bullpup assault rifle.
One of the two main variants, both were accepted into the Lysorian military in the late 1978s and are being phased out slowly with the M416.
The FAMAS F1 uses a proprietary 25-round magazine with Lysorian made ammo and a smaller trigger guard. It is the slowest firing variant but hits the hardest.
Burst fire reduces recoil by 20% and increases RPM by 100!

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
